entities.summary: Almohad, a notable figure in the history of Spain, associated with The Reconquista (1085–1250). Preceded by El Cid & the High Reconquista and Alfonso VI of Castile captures Toledo. Their legacy influenced Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa – turning point of the Reconquista and Nasrid Kingdom.
